baseline_mode: clingo: one stable model, one worker; Souffle: compiled -j 1, external fact files, default optimizations, no magic-set flag
workload_unit: fresh process, full input load and every listed ground query; query order fixed within a workload
memory: Linux GNU time maximum resident set size in KiB for the entire process; not incremental KB memory
statistics: median and linear-interpolated quartiles over 15 measured samples per cell; completed samples only for latency, with cutoff and failure counts alongside; no substitution of 30 seconds as a completed latency
proof_cost: fresh-engine certify_text (includes reasoning) versus fresh-engine query_holds; validation, JSON serialization, bytes and steps separately
freeze_rule: smoke must pass before freeze; measured runs refuse any change to hashed protocol, generator, driver, runner or engine sources; changed evidence requires a new freeze and directory
